An '''ion accelerator''' was a component of the [[Jawa ionization blaster/Legends|Jawa ionization blaster]], created by fixing an [[Accu-accelerator/Legends|accu-accelerator]] from a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] ignition system to a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]].<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref> The [[Jawa ionization blaster/Legends|Jawa ionization blaster]] employed both primary and secondary ion accelerators.<ref name="EGWT" />
